lines.zh: 佛莱迪站在舞台中央，不动
lines.en: Freddy stands centre stage, unmoving.

lines.zh: 他的脚固定在展示底座上
lines.en: His feet are fixed to the display base.

lines.zh: 他只把上身向前倾了倾
lines.en: He only leans his upper body forward.
His top hat sits slightly askew.
He tries to move a foot; nothing gives.

lines.zh: 他的重心左右换了一换
lines.en: His weight shifts side to side.
His hand lifts, then falls.
The microphone hangs by his hand.

lines.zh: 他的影子在台上缓缓摆
lines.en: His shadow sways slowly on the stage.
His motion looks slowed down.
He cannot complete that step forward.
He stands straight, as if hosting.
Freddy inclines his head slightly.
His eyes come slowly alight.
His hat catches the light.
His jaw moves once.

lines.zh: 他的手指扶正了话筒架
lines.en: His fingers straighten the mic stand.
Music leaks from his chest.
Then the music cuts off.
He tilts, as if waiting for applause.
Dust falls from his shoulders.
His bow tie sits a little crooked.

lines.zh: 他抬手碰了碰自己的帽檐
lines.en: He touches his hat brim.

lines.zh: 他的动作停在半途，很久
lines.en: His gesture freezes halfway, for a long time.
The motor hum winds down.

lines.zh: 他一动不动，像在等开场
lines.en: He holds still, waiting to begin.
Freddy's head turns square to you.

lines.zh: 他抬起帽檐看了你一眼
lines.en: He lifts his brim to look at you.
His smile is fixed in place.

lines.zh: 他的目光稳稳地压着你
lines.en: His stare rests steadily on you.
He bows slightly to you.
He raises the mic to his mouth.

lines.zh: 他没有说话，只是张了张嘴
lines.en: He does not speak, only opens his mouth.
He lowers the mic again.
His eyes do not blink.

lines.zh: 他在判断你是不是观众
lines.en: He is deciding whether you are audience.
He points at the front of the stage.
He seems to invite you closer.

lines.zh: 他的身体轻轻晃了一下
lines.en: His body rocks once.

lines.zh: 他的视线落到你的手上
lines.en: His gaze drops to your hands.
He slowly levels his head.
He cannot retreat; he only stands.
His shadow stays over you.
He is waiting for you to speak first.

lines.zh: 佛莱迪被击中，晃了一下
lines.en: Freddy is struck and rocks.
His hat falls off.
He bends to retrieve it.
A crack opens in his casing.
The music in his chest trips.
His eyes flicker twice.
He cannot retreat; he only lists.

lines.zh: 他把帽子戴回去，动作很慢
lines.en: He sets the hat back, slowly.
His jaw shakes once.
He levels himself and stands on.

lines.zh: 佛莱迪垂眼看着你手里的东西
lines.en: Freddy looks down at what you hold.
He reaches out and takes it.
He holds it up to examine.

lines.zh: 他把它放进胸前的柜里
lines.en: He puts it in the cabinet in his chest.
He has no need of food.

lines.zh: 他摇了摇头，把东西还你
lines.en: He shakes his head and returns it.

lines.zh: 他把东西摆在台上当道具
lines.en: He sets it on the stage as a prop.

lines.zh: 他的乐声短暂地高了半调
lines.en: His music lifts half a tone.

lines.zh: 他伸出手，要你再给一件
lines.en: He puts out a hand for one more.
He pats his own chest lightly.

lines.zh: 你撞上佛莱迪，他微微后仰
lines.en: You hit Freddy and he rocks back.
His hat slips a little.
He lifts a hand to right it.
He is far heavier than you.
He gives half an inch, then returns.
His arm blocks the aisle.
You edge past his side.
The motor note changes.
He looks down to check you are unhurt.
He settles back into his pose.

lines.zh: 佛莱迪与乐队成员并肩站着
lines.en: Freddy stands beside his bandmates.
They all face the same way.

lines.zh: 三具身体同时微微前倾
lines.en: Three frames lean forward together.
Music runs between them.

lines.zh: 他们的头一起歪向一侧
lines.en: Their heads tilt as one.

lines.zh: 同一段程序让他们同步
lines.en: One program keeps them in step.
Their eyes light at the same moment.

lines.zh: 灯光在他们之间来回扫
lines.en: The light sweeps across them.
No dialogue passes between them.

lines.zh: 他们就这样演了一整夜
lines.en: They play that show all night.

lines.zh: 佛莱迪弯腰，关节响了一声
lines.en: Freddy bends; a joint clicks.

lines.zh: 他拾起东西，先看了一眼
lines.en: He picks it up and gives it a look.

lines.zh: 他用指尖擦掉上面的灰
lines.en: He wipes the dust off with a fingertip.

lines.zh: 他把它摆在台上的定位点
lines.en: He sets it on a mark on the stage.

lines.zh: 他把不用的收进了胸口
lines.en: What he does not need goes in his chest.

lines.zh: 他拾取时动作非常规矩
lines.en: His movements are extremely precise.

lines.zh: 他把它举起来给台下看
lines.en: He lifts it up for the audience.
He lays it flat and squares it.
He tests the weight and puts it back.
Done, he straightens again.
Freddy's head comes up sharply.
His eyes flare white.
The music stops.
He lowers the microphone slowly.

lines.zh: 他的身体朝前压了一点
lines.en: He presses his body forward.

lines.zh: 胸腔里传出低低的杂音
lines.en: Low static comes from his chest.
His jaw parts.

lines.zh: 他的礼帽阴影盖住了眼睛
lines.en: His hat's shadow covers his eyes.

lines.zh: 他的动作忽然变得很快
lines.en: His movements suddenly speed up.

lines.zh: 他朝你的方向倾得更多
lines.en: He leans further your way.

lines.zh: 他的脚还是没离开底座
lines.en: His feet still have not left the base.

lines.zh: 他的手指在话筒上收紧
lines.en: His fingers tighten on the mic.

lines.zh: 他把你列进了今晚的节目
lines.en: He has put you in tonight's show.

lines.zh: 他的影子往前挪了一格
lines.en: His shadow advances a block.

lines.zh: 台上的一切都安静下来
lines.en: Everything on stage goes quiet.
He is ready to begin.

lines.zh: 佛莱迪一直朝着你站着
lines.en: Freddy keeps himself turned to you.
He shifts his weight forward, slowly.
His head turns with you.

lines.zh: 他的动作一帧一帧地靠近
lines.en: He closes in frame by frame.
He tries to step down and jams.
His eyes stay lit.

lines.zh: 他把帽檐往上推，露出眼睛
lines.en: He pushes the brim up to bare his eyes.

lines.zh: 他的影子把你整个罩住
lines.en: His shadow covers all of you.

lines.zh: 他把话筒举到嘴边，又放下
lines.en: He raises the mic, then lowers it.

lines.zh: 他的胸口传出断续的乐声
lines.en: Broken music spills from his chest.
His head tilts and stops.

lines.zh: 他的手臂慢慢抬到腰高
lines.en: His arm rises to waist height.

lines.zh: 我僵在舞台上，眼睛却一直追着你。
lines.en: Stiff on stage, yet my eyes keep following you.
The stage lights flicker.
His frame shudders.
Then he goes entirely still.
That stillness carries weight.
He is waiting on your next move.
Freddy sweeps an arm across.

lines.zh: 他的话筒架砸在你肩上
lines.en: The mic stand cracks your shoulder.
He seizes your arm.

lines.zh: 他的下颚咬在你的护甲上
lines.en: His jaw clamps on your armour.

lines.zh: 他推你的胸口，力气很大
lines.en: A hard push at your chest.

lines.zh: 他的礼帽在动作里歪了
lines.en: His hat slips with the motion.
A shoulder plate rams you.

lines.zh: 他的动作很稳，没有破绽
lines.en: His motion is steady, showing nothing.
The miss switches hands instantly.

lines.zh: 他借着前倾把力加上去
lines.en: The lean adds weight to the blow.

lines.zh: 他的手指掐进你的衣袖
lines.en: His fingers dig into your sleeve.
He pulls back and fixes his hat.
Music still plays in his chest.
The second swing comes faster.
His feet never moved.
He is still smiling when he stops.
The stage spotlight comes on.
Freddy stands in the middle of the beam.

lines.zh: 他把帽檐压得低了一点
lines.en: He draws the brim a shade lower.
Two white points light his eyes.

lines.zh: 他胸口的乐声先响起来
lines.en: The music in his chest starts first.
Dust settles slowly in the beam.
His head turns to the seats.

lines.zh: 他向前倾了一下，施了个礼
lines.en: He leans into a little bow.

lines.zh: 他的话筒架在地上磕了一声
lines.en: The mic stand taps the floor.

lines.zh: 他身上的旧污渍清晰可见
lines.en: The old stains show plainly.

lines.zh: 他已经站在那个位置上很久
lines.en: He has stood on that mark a long time.
He begins tonight's hosting.
His joints settle into place.
His shadow falls on the red curtain.

lines.zh: 他站得笔直，像一尊塑像
lines.en: He stands straight as a statue.
He lets the courtesy fade.

lines.zh: 灯光在他身后聚成一圈
lines.en: The light rings him from behind.
He stops moving.

lines.zh: 他的布料烧起来，微笑没变
lines.en: His cloth burns and the smile stays.

lines.zh: 摔下台时他的帽子先落地
lines.en: He falls; the hat lands first.
Water fills his chest and the music stops.

lines.zh: 爆炸撕开了他半边外壳
lines.en: The blast tears half his casing away.
An arrow sticks in beside his bow tie.

lines.zh: 怪力让他全身抽了一下
lines.en: Odd force convulses his frame.

lines.zh: 电池将尽，他的动作迟滞
lines.en: Battery nearly gone, his motion drags.

lines.zh: 雷击让他整个人跳起来
lines.en: Lightning bounces him off the floor.

lines.zh: 虚空拽他，帽子先飘走了
lines.en: The void pulls; the hat drifts away first.
